gen-fs-karma-satoshi: Comfortable and refined, Karma keeps its serif contrast tame, with tall rounded lowercase forms. But what stands out most is the gap between Karma's gentle weight shifts and Satoshi's uniform, wide-open strokes.
gen-fs-kohinoor-zerone-fs-neco: Kohinoor Zerone draws round, wire-bent letters with contemporary precision, best left to just a few words. Neco swells gently from hairline to stem and handles the dignified, authoritative running text.
gen-fs-kohinoor-zerone-fs-recia: Kohinoor Zerone draws round, precise letters like bent wire, with diagonals as hefty as its stems. And Recia's gentle modulation keeps openings generous, which suits a quick bit of reading.
gen-fs-merriweather-sans-fs-erode: Erode brings a tall middle band, shallow ascenders and descenders, and a gentle ebb and flow of stroke weight to the text. Merriweather Sans offers big, glassy counters; Erode offers dignified editorial text.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-hepta-slab: Locked together like links in a fine chain, New Title stands tall in its lowercase. And Hepta Slab, with open counters and curves and straights sharing one width, is the stretched-out partner to that tight chain.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-kiwi-maru: Letters locked together like links in a fine chain, and a lowercase that towers over the capitals, define New Title. Kiwi Maru, with ring-round o's and distant terminals, is the traditional counterweight.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-padyakke-expanded-on: Padyakke Expanded One spreads its glyphs like knots on a slack rope, with a pitcher-wide mouth in each c. Padyakke Expanded One keeps a constant pen-like line, while New Title locks its tall letters together.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Modern, New Title locks its tall lowercase together like chain links. Stint Ultra Expanded lets each character float apart, so extended reading moves at an unhurried pace, counters leading outward.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-fauna-one: Oswald packs its rows tight and speaks with confidence. Fauna One brings a tall middle band, shallow ascenders and descenders, and a generous entry into the e, all literary and dignified.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-glegoo: Oswald knits its rows tightly and speaks with confident strength, a display face with a moderate lowercase. Then Glegoo's big counters and tall lowercase give those rows somewhere refined and editorial to land.
